subject: English
passage: The thirty-six artesian wells of Florida's Silver Springs State Park are fed through a mechanism called natural aquifer discharge, in which underground water flows upward through limestone—in this instance, the permeable bedrock layers beneath Silver ______ emerge in crystal-clear pools.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is the punctuation of a supplementary element within a sentence. The dash after "Springs" pairs with the dash after "limestone" to separate the supplementary element "in this instance, the permeable bedrock layers beneath Silver Springs" from the rest of the sentence.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because it fails to use appropriate punctuation to separate the supplementary element from the rest of the sentence.
